points: EU plans up to EUR 10bn public funding for up to seven AI gigafactories; up to EUR 1bn per largest site
Largest class needs at least 100,000 AI processors; applications close 3 December 2026
Hochtief and Vodafone declined to comment; parent ACS reportedly bids separately with Telefonica
take: A German builder, possibly with Vodafone, joins the race for EU-funded AI data centres. Unconfirmed, but it signals more German capacity bids before the deadline.
title: Handelsblatt: Hochtief prepares its own bid for an EU AI gigafactory
